high_level_description: The image is a slide from a presentation titled "Biological Distributed Algorithms." The slide discusses how various biological systems exhibit characteristics of distributed algorithms. The background of the slide is white with a green header at the top. Title: Biological Distributed Algorithms Main Points: Many kinds of biological systems behave like distributed algorithms, e.g.: Cells in developing organisms organize themselves into meaningful patterns. Insect colonies cooperate to solve problems of cooperative exploration, task allocation, consensus.
